notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Wild Idea using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Wild Idea using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sanar, Unfinished Genius.
When Sanar, Unfinished Genius enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
